name: lit_petals
description: an ornate rosette of smoothly lit petals, cream and gold in the outer bands and orange, maroon and plum further in, each band a soft dome lit from the upper left with a dark seam between, their edges crusted with small jewel-like decorations in teal, gold and maroon, on a deep teal ground

reference.made_with: an escape-time render signed 'exoteric.roach.org' (Ultra Fractal by its look), 2560x1600

reuses: field smooth through the map by rank, once: the depth order of the reference's rosette (teal ground, cream and gold outer petals, orange, maroon and plum inner ones), read off a cyclic map so the jewels can cycle it
the light layer on field smooth at period 3 with no tube (rings 0, slope 1: the soft formulation, Matt's keep and the default since item 025): every three escape steps one smooth rise, the petal
the same count cycled three times round the map and lit at one step a ring, masked to the set's neighbourhood by the inverted distance estimate at power 25: the jewels
glow_filaments' falloff glow on de, painted near-black and multiplied: the dark hair outlining each jewel
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10

notes: Added: nothing: the smooth count through a cyclic map, lit at `period` 3, and cycled three times under a `de` mask for the jewels. Its default stack is the `soft` formulation (no tube, no seam sheet), the one Matt kept

Lessons: The twelfth style is a rosette of smoothly lit petals, cream and gold outside and orange, maroon and plum within, crusted at their edges with tiny jewels on a teal ground, and it went in with **no new primitive**: the petals are the smooth count through the map by rank, lit at `period` 3 with a dark period sheet for the seam; the jewels are the same count cycled three times round the map and lit once a step, masked to the set by the inverted distance estimate at power 25, with a dark falloff hair outlining them. Three lessons. **A petal is several escape steps**: a light at `period` 1 (`gilded_orbs`' filigree) draws every petal of a gallery seat as a stack of corrugated ridges, and at 3 each lobe between the arms lights as one soft dome. **On lace, a jewel's colour has to come from the map, not from a glow**: every lace sample lies within a hair of the set, so the gold halo and hair glows of the earlier styles painted the whole fringe one khaki, and a flat teal paint under gold bead lattices read as a beaded texture rather than jewels; cycling the petals' own map, made **cyclic** (teal ground through cream, gold, maroon and plum back to teal) so the cycles meet no seam, gives each decoration its own teal, gold or maroon. **The jewels hold the highlights**: the stack held the reference's balance at all 40 scout drafts and the eleven full renders, while the same petals with the jewels taken off read p90 0.75–0.79 against 0.65 at both formulation seats, the cream petals unbroken by the dark crust. The galleries hold petals at almost every non-spiral seat, so the locations are an ordinary scout with no ink filter, whirls dropped by eye.
